description: Selection cases for every runner (runner-integration §4.1): `files` is a synthetic vectors/ tree (paths relative to vectors/; a wire file carries its kind and, when set, its activation_rule); each case gives a runner.json scope and the sorted paths it selects. A runner reproduces every case before it grades.

cases.name: eval-v6-takes-every-slot
cases.description: A v6 runner selects every version slot of its tier: any, v4, v5 and v6.

cases.name: eval-v5-stops-at-v5
cases.description: Versions are cumulative up to the declared one: v5 takes any, v4 and v5, not v6.

cases.name: eval-v4-takes-v4-and-any
cases.description: The lowest slot takes itself and any.

cases.name: tiers-are-not-cumulative
cases.description: Only the declared tiers are selected; declaring transaction and block pulls in no eval or wire file.

cases.name: a-scope-may-select-nothing
cases.description: A version below every file of the declared tiers selects nothing: an empty selection, not an error.

cases.name: wire-every-kind
cases.description: Without kinds, every wire kind is selected; without activation, activation_rule files are too.

cases.name: wire-declared-kinds
cases.description: A wire file is selected only when its one kind is declared.

cases.name: wire-no-activation-drops-activation-rule-files
cases.description: activation false drops a file whose envelope says activation_rule true; an absent activation_rule counts as false.

cases.name: wire-kinds-and-activation-together
cases.description: Both wire rules apply: the one Constant file is an activation_rule file, so nothing is selected.

cases.name: wire-a-kind-at-its-version
cases.description: A declared kind is still held to the version rule.

cases.name: wire-v4-takes-any
cases.description: The any slot is selected at every version, wire included.

cases.name: every-tier-cost-plays-no-part
cases.description: Every tier at v6 selects every vector; the root grading.json and a non-JSON file are not vectors; cost does not affect selection.

cases.name: any-only-tiers-at-v4
cases.description: Files in the any slot are selected even at the lowest version.
